title: 2010 ADA Standards: swimming pools
edition: 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design §242 and §1009
notes: Applies with the ADA rule set. Pool lifts, sloped entries, transfer walls, transfer systems and accessible pool stairs count as means of entry; at least one must be a lift or sloped entry.

pool.description: Two accessible means of entry, one of them a pool lift or sloped entry; one (a lift or sloped entry) where the pool wall is under 300 linear ft
A wading pool has a sloped entry
